entries.name: On Attack / On Crit (+ Wielding: Bow)

system.description: For when you have no choice but to fight unarmed.
A specialist marksman, the Ranger has access to powerful abilities that make them a formidable wielder of the bow. Flying units must beware a Ranger's watchful aim.
Difficult terrain tiles have 1 reduced movement cost. For example, tiles which would normally cost 2 movement cost 1 instead. Tiles which normally cost 3, cost 2 instead.
Launch an attack from your bow, enhanced with deadly venom. Each hit deals an additional 2d6 Decay damage and 1 Brk.

A bow commonly found amongst military archers.

Effective against Flying units.
A well-crafted, well-balanced, double-edged sword. The minimum standard of quality for common soldiers and adventurers.
An agile garb that offers superior light armor protections.
